title: Stop the 3-seat style-check unit test timing out on CI
description: Main CI run 45992781358 (commit 8bea902) failed once in 'Unit tests with coverage': tests/playtest/style-check-short-handed.test.ts 'style check tallies TAG mixed spots with the short-handed chart at 3 seats' timed out at vitest's default 5000 ms (it runs main() with 300 hands under coverage). The failed-job re-run passed. Make the test's runtime comfortably inside its budget on CI.

nodes.title: Stop the 3-seat style-check unit test timing out on CI

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given tests/playtest/style-check-short-handed.test.ts, When it runs under npm test with coverage on CI and locally, Then it finishes well inside its time limit (e.g. by tallying fewer hands while still exercising both 3-seat TAG mixed spots, or an explicit per-test timeout sized from measured CI time), with no assertion removed or loosened
